name: moon
description: A balanced crescent moon with a clean circular concavity.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The crescent preserves the recognizable lunar silhouette as an intentional circular exception to the rounded rectangular object baseline. Two radius-8 circles separated by vector 4,-4 define the exterior and concavity; a single closed contour avoids doubled edges. The drawing is translated so its native centerline bounds are x/y=4.35424869..19.64575131; Regular 1.70 gives equal opposite visible margins of 3.50424869. Rounded stroke joins soften both horns without decorative stars or extra details. Static draft awaiting owner review.
